findings.problem: placeholderData was added to the shared hook, so every consumer keeps the previous response when the query key changes, not only GuestPortalPage. StaffIntakePage changes status and IntakeQueue changes workspaceId; with placeholder data isLoading stays false and neither consumer renders isPlaceholderData, so rows from the old filter are displayed as if they belong to the new one.
findings.why: Selecting 'Rejected' briefly shows rows of the previous tab with no loading or dimming affordance. On a slow self-hosted instance this can last seconds and a reviewer can act on the wrong list.
findings.fix: Opt in only for the guest portal, e.g. placeholderData: group === undefined ? undefined : (previousData) => previousData (staff never passes group), or add an explicit keepPreviousData argument passed only by GuestPortalPage; alternatively dim the staff list with isPlaceholderData.

findings.problem: Page-1 items and extra-page items are merged without deduplicating across the two sources; the dedupe in useGetIntakeRequestPages only covers pages 2..N. Page 1 and page 2 poll independently every 30s, so a status change between the two responses can put the same request on both pages.
findings.why: Renders the request twice and produces a duplicate React key warning; items.length can also exceed the real row count used by the show-all condition. Transient but visible while polling.
findings.fix: Dedupe the merged list by id in GuestPortalPage before rendering and before the items.length < total check, e.g. [...new Map([...(requests.data?.items ?? []), ...(showAll ? extraPages.items : [])].map((item) => [item.id, item])).values()].

findings.problem: The 'All requests' legend row hides its percent (showPercent = group !== 'all'), while the approved behaviour says each of the 4 filter buttons shows count and percent. Group percentages use the open-work total (total={active}) while the header count is counts.all, which includes finished requests.
findings.why: The summary shows one row without the promised percent, and percentages that do not relate to the total shown next to the heading; a guest with finished requests sees numbers that do not add up.
findings.fix: Confirm the approved design: render the All row's percent (100%) and label the denominator, or document that percents are shares of open work.

findings.problem: The generated locale schema was not regenerated after adding the P2 keys. intake.portal.required is still ['nav','title','all','newRequest'] and has no properties for overview/group/banner/legend/showAll/emptyGroup or the new list columns, although CONTRIBUTING.md asks to run pnpm i18n:schema before a PR and earlier i18n commits updated this file.
findings.why: The published schema (editor/tooling validation, additionalProperties:false) rejects every new key, so translation tooling and editors report false errors. CI only runs i18n:check, so nothing catches it.
findings.fix: Run pnpm i18n:schema and commit the regenerated i18n/schema.json.

findings.problem: The column header uses grid grid-cols-2 with five labels below the sm breakpoint, while each data row is flex flex-wrap; at 375px the labels land in a 2-column grid ('ID | Request', 'Project | Status', 'Received') that does not line up with the row content order.
findings.why: The header is misleading on phones: 'Status' sits next to 'Project' and 'Received' is orphaned, so the labels no longer identify the row fields.
findings.fix: Hide the header on small screens (hidden sm:grid) and keep the labels from sm up, where the five-column template applies; or give rows the same 2-column grid at mobile.

findings.problem: The comment above INTAKE_STATUS_TONES still says 'the label always comes from intake:status.*', but IntakeStatusBadge now accepts a label override and the guest list passes intake:portal.group.* labels.
findings.why: A stale comment misleads the next reader about where badge text comes from (OCR delegate rule: comments should explain the code).
findings.fix: Update the comment to say the tone comes from the status while the label may be overridden (guest group wording).

findings.problem: A failed extra-page fetch is invisible: the pages hook combine exposes only items/isFetching/refetch, so when pages 2..N error the show-all button silently returns to its normal label and the loaded rows stay partial.
findings.why: Guests with more than one page get no error or retry hint when the second request fails (OCR delegate rule: null/error checks), and the 'Show all N requests' button looks like it did nothing.
findings.fix: Expose isError from the pages combine and render the existing intake:list.loadError + retry (or keep the button disabled with an error label) when it is set.
findings.source: OCR delegate rule (Null Checks) + own reading

findings.problem: The new pages hook (page math + id dedupe) has no test; guest-portal-page.test.tsx mocks the hook away, so M3's dedupe and the 2..N page range are only exercised indirectly.
findings.why: The most bug-prone new logic (offsets, dedupe, empty totalPages) is the only P2 logic without a regression test.
findings.fix: Add a small unit test for the combine/page math (or renderHook with a mocked fetcher) covering totalPages 0/1/3 and a duplicated id.
